name: print-social-black-and-neon-lime-recruitment-posts
title: Black and neon lime job-vacancy and referral posts with 3D molecules
whatItIs: A cluster of vertical black cards with heavy condensed lime headlines like 'MANAGER', 'REF' and 'MEET THE TEAM', accompanied by glossy black 3D molecule or star objects and small label chips.
whatItMeans: Edgy, high-energy and startup-like; neon lime on black feels like a signal.
techniques: Set job titles in giant condensed caps in one neon colour.
Add glossy black 3D objects to give depth to text posts.
Use small chips (VACANCY, REELS) as category tags.
Alternate solid lime cards with black ones.

vocabulary.definition: A very bright colour on a dark background.
A glossy render of connected spheres.
A small label describing a post type.
